stories.title: New York governor vows to close legal loophole after Cornell gang rape allegations
stories.summary: Following public outcry over an alleged gang rape at Cornell University in 2024, New York Governor Kathy Hochul called for closing a loophole in state law that allows offenders to avoid rape charges if their victims were willingly intoxicated.

stories.title: Iraq celebrates departure of international coalition and last US troops
stories.summary: Baghdad declared October 1 a day of celebration, ending 23 years of American military presence since the March 2003 invasion. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump hailed a 'victory' for both countries.

stories.summary: Aryna Sabalenka says she is "trying so hard to be easier on myself" as she begins her China Open campaign with victory over Renata Zarazua.

stories.title: Fils beats Tiafoe in rare Top 10 clash as Jacquet, Vacherot and Munar complete Tokyo quarterfinals
stories.summary: Arthur Fils (Q) beat Frances Tiafoe (No. 2) 6-3, 7-5 on Friday in Tokyo, in only the second meeting of two Top 10 players in a second round since 1992. Vacherot, Jacquet and Munar also reached the quarterfinals.

kev.name: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
kev.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

kev.name: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
kev.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.
